name: Spider Cloud
description: Spider Cloud web extraction: crawl a site to markdown, scrape a single page, list a page's links, or run a web search. Renders JS and uses premium proxies to get past bot walls. Useful for company-website extraction and enrichment as a RevCode column function.
author: the upstream workspace (custom)

scrape.name: Scrape Page
scrape.description: Extract a single page as markdown (or other format). Returns an array with one page object: content, url, status.
scrape.instructions: url is the page to extract. request controls rendering: smart (auto-pick, default) and chrome render JavaScript; http is fastest but returns empty on JS-heavy or protected pages. proxy_enabled (default true) uses premium proxies to get past bot walls. The response is an array; raw holds the whole array, content holds the first page's text.

url.description: URL of the page to extract.

request.description: http | chrome | smart. smart/chrome render JS; http is fastest.

proxy_enabled.description: Use premium proxies to bypass bot walls.

crawl.name: Crawl Site
crawl.description: Crawl multiple pages of a site to markdown. Returns an array of page objects (content, url, status), one per crawled page.
crawl.instructions: url is the starting URL. limit caps how many pages to crawl (default 10). request and proxy_enabled behave as in Scrape Page. raw holds the full array of crawled pages; content holds the first page's text.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl.

proxy_enabled.description: Use premium proxies to bypass bot walls.

links.name: List Links
links.description: Return the links found on a page or site.
links.instructions: url is the page to read links from. limit caps how many to return.

limit.description: Maximum number of links to return.

proxy_enabled.description: Use premium proxies to bypass bot walls.

search.name: Web Search
search.description: Run a web search through Spider Cloud and return result entries.
search.instructions: search is the query string. limit caps the number of results.
